side_effects: Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.

Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).

components.name: Sandbox
components.summary: World context variable of the sandbox: the rules of life, the species, the grass, the counters.

fields.name: params

fields.name: base
fields.desc: as the file (with the scene's overrides) has them

fields.name: next_group
fields.desc: the next ragdoll group, from 1

fields.name: windows
fields.desc: Observe phases so far (minds are due when (windows + phase) % mind_every == 0)

fields.name: seconds
fields.desc: simulated since the start or the last RESET

fields.name: puppet
fields.desc: a check: kinematic bodies slid along their command, no walker agents

fields.name: heuristic
fields.desc: the scripted minds answer the minds nothing answered (in Sandbox's tick)

fields.name: draw
fields.desc: shapes (Transform + WorldShape + ModelRef) per body and grass tiles for WorldView

fields.name: rewards_dir
fields.desc: resources folder of <species>.rewards.json

fields.name: contacts
fields.desc: contacts between two animals so far

fields.name: blows
fields.desc: ... of which wounded

Its presence makes TrainHost treat the scene as a sandbox scene.

fields.name: runner

components.notes: Emplaced by ModelWatcher's constructor, filled at its first tick, updated at every load; read by SphereView.

components.name: Sky
components.summary: Host context variable: the time of day and the place, from which the sun, the moon and the sky follow.

fields.name: time
fields.desc: hours, 0 to 24 (default 10.3349: the sun at normalize(0.5, 1, 0.5))

fields.name: day_length
fields.desc: seconds of play for a day; 0: the sun is stopped

fields.name: latitude
fields.desc: degrees (42.8, Tautavel)

fields.name: declination
fields.desc: degrees: the season (14.787)

components.notes: Set by the Sky system (constructor) and moved by its tick; the renderer's Lights emplaces a default one when a scene has no Sky system. skyLight(Sky) gives the directional light, sky colours and ambient light (mirrored by the shaders). Read by Lights, TreeShade, the debug menu (which may change the time).

components.name: Plant
components.summary: A plant of the vegetation library next to a Transform (uniform scale), drawn by VegetationPass.

fields.name: species
fields.desc: index in VegetationLibrary::species

fields.name: lod
fields.desc: -1: level of detail by screen height; >= 0: always this level (clamped); Plant::volume (-2): always from the species' baked volume

components.notes: Created by Forest and VegetationScatter (per chunk, destroyed with the chunk through ChunkForest / ChunkPlants) and VegetationLineup (kept). Read by VegetationPass, TreeShade (crown shadows), PlantVolumes, ProbeVolume, RayScene, HerdSys (trunks to walk around).

components.name: ChunkForest
components.summary: On a chunk: the plants Forest put on it, destroyed with the chunk.

fields.name: plants
fields.desc: the plant entities of the chunk

components.notes: Emplaced by Forest when it plants a chunk (also empty, to mark it planted); its on_destroy signal (connected by Forest) destroys the plants. Read by CameraWalk (trunks to route around).

components.name: ChunkPlants
components.summary: On a chunk: the plants VegetationScatter put on it, destroyed with the chunk.

fields.name: plants
fields.desc: the plant entities of the chunk

components.notes: Emplaced by VegetationScatter (also empty, to mark it done); its on_destroy signal destroys the plants.

components.name: VegetationLibrary
components.summary: Host context variable: the index of resources/vegetation (SpeedTree species imported by tools/speedtree_import.py).

fields.name: directory
fields.desc: the library folder (./resources/vegetation, else the source tree's)

fields.name: species
fields.desc: id, name, category (ground, shrub, tree), height, radius, triangles of the most detailed level, number of levels

components.notes: Created on first use by vegetationLibrary(reg) (Forest, VegetationScatter, VegetationLineup, VegetationPass, HerdSys, CameraWalk...), empty when the folder has no library.json. loadSpecies / loadGeometry read species/<id>.json and .bin on demand.

components.name: ForestField
components.summary: Host context variable (held as std::shared_ptr<ForestField>): forest cover 0..1 and stand from patch noise and the land's slope, on an 8 m lattice anchored to the world.

fields.name: params
fields.desc: seed, patch_size, coverage, edge, max_slope, slope_fade, slope_reach, stand_size

fields.name: generator
fields.desc: (private) the heightfield the slope is measured on

fields.name: patches
fields.desc: (private) FBm simplex, 4 octaves: the patch noise

fields.name: stands
fields.desc: (private) FBm simplex, 2 octaves: the stand noise

fields.name: cover_low
fields.desc: (private) patch noise where the forest starts (measured quantile)

fields.name: cover_high
fields.desc: (private) ... and where it is thick

fields.name: stand_sorted
fields.desc: (private) sorted samples of the stand noise, to make it uniform

components.notes: The context variable is std::shared_ptr<ForestField>, insert_or_assign'ed by Forest in init. Thread safe (const queries). Read by CameraWalk and HerdSys.

components.name: VegetationPreload
components.summary: Host context variable: species VegetationPass loads before any plant uses them.

fields.name: species
fields.desc: library indices, sorted

components.notes: Written by Forest in init (every species of its layers); read by VegetationPass.

components.name: VegetationStats
components.summary: Host context variable written by VegetationPass: how many plants, how many drawn, species loaded and loading.

fields.name: plants
fields.desc: Plant entities

fields.name: drawn
fields.desc: instances drawn on the desktop target

fields.name: triangles
fields.desc: triangles drawn

fields.name: species_loaded
fields.desc: species in GPU memory

fields.name: species_loading
fields.desc: asked for and not drawn yet: plants are missing

components.notes: Emplaced by VegetationPass; read by the debug menu and by captures (they wait for species_loading == 0).
